name: cloud-media-center
description: Cloud Media Center — a photo/video gallery app forked from IacobIonut01/ReFra (ex-com.dot.gallery). Single-app fork (NOT a hub+forks constellation like ea_cloud-comms/ea_cloud-ide): one APK, one materialized upstream tracker. Extends the upstream local MediaStore gallery with two additional non-local media sources behind the SAME Album/MediaItem model: an HTTP 'manifest' source (WG-gated JSON index + thumbs, also used to mirror Instagram via a server-side gallery-dl job) and a 'newpipe' source (NewPipeExtractor, YouTube only). See data/media-profiles.json for the profile registry — Kotlin iterates it, never a hardcoded source list.
_doc_mode: Engine data-signal (cloud-comms-fork-engine.sh) opting this app OUT of the hub+bundle-forks+IPC-contract model used by ea_cloud-{mail,chat,dialer,matrix}. Absence of this key (their build.json shape) means the engine's original hub-coupled steps run unchanged; 'single-app' means the engine builds+signs the one forks.<key> entry directly via the existing step_build_fork machinery.

android._doc_min_sdk: 29, not 26 used by ea_cloud-ide/nav/mail — inherited as-is from upstream ReFra's own minSdk (verified 2026-07-26 against app/build.gradle.kts on main; a prior scaffold pass fabricated 30). Lowering it would require patching upstream Compose/media APIs we don't intend to touch.

license._doc: Upstream ReFra (ex-Gallery) is Apache-2.0. OUR fork is GPL-3.0 for the whole app, NOT Apache-2.0, because we statically link com.github.teamnewpipe:NewPipeExtractor (GPL-3.0, pulled via JitPack for the 'newpipe' YouTube source — see data/media-profiles.json::profiles[youtube]). GPL-3.0 is a stricter copyleft than Apache-2.0; combining a GPL-3.0 dependency into the app requires the resulting APK/derivative work to be distributed under GPL-3.0 terms. This is a DECIDED relicense, not an oversight — record it verbatim in README.md and in the app's about/licenses screen once implemented.
license.relicense_reason: GPL-3.0 copyleft dependency (NewPipeExtractor) pulled into the app for the YouTube 'newpipe' media source

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps (Cloud-Comms hub+forks, Cloud-Nav, Cloud-IDE, Cloud-SuperApp, and now Cloud-Media-Center). Same key so cross-app signature-IPC + the in-app fleet updater never hit a signature mismatch. KEY LOCATION (raw credential + sops passwords live ONLY in the vault repo): A0_keys/providers/android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A0_keys/providers/android/signing.secrets.yaml. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR (default ~/git/vault) + sops-decrypts the passwords, exporting ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE/ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD which the gradle signingConfig (or a written keystore.properties for the upstream tracker) reads. CI does the same via a vault checkout + the SOPS_AGE_KEY secret. THERE IS NO FALLBACK: if the key is unavailable the build FAILS LOUD telling you to use the one shared key — it never generates or substitutes a random/legacy key. Copied verbatim from ea_cloud-mail/build.json::signing.

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility, mirrored in flake.nix — keep in sync. Same AGP/Gradle/Kotlin/JDK pins as ea_cloud-ide / ea_cloud-nav so all constellation Android projects share one toolchain story. NOTE: the fork itself builds via its OWN gradlew (see fork.build below) which may pin different AGP/Gradle versions upstream — this toolchain block covers OUR devShell tooling (adb/jq/oras/gh), not necessarily what actually compiles the fork.
toolchain._doc_ndk: REQUIRED, not optional — verified 2026-07-26 against upstream app/build.gradle.kts: ReFra has externalNativeBuild + CMake, with JNI over libheif/libde265. A prior scaffold pass wrongly assumed this is a pure Kotlin/Compose app with no native code and pinned a stale NDK for schema parity only; that assumption was wrong.
toolchain._doc_cmake: REQUIRED alongside ndk above — CMake version pinned by upstream's build.gradle.kts externalNativeBuild block. Must be kept in sync with flake.nix::androidenv.composeAndroidPackages.cmakeVersions.

diagnostics._doc: Same shape as ea_cloud-ide::diagnostics. Baked into BuildConfig.LOG_SINK_URL / LOG_SINK_STREAM once the fork's build.gradle is patched to read it (not done yet — no patches/ series exists). EMPTY behavior until wired: cloud push disabled. Data-driven — never hardcode in Kotlin.

media-center._doc: Plural 'forks.<key>' map — same shape as ea_cloud-mail/build.json::forks.mail (and chat/dialer/matrix), reconciled 2026-07-26 to match the engine's existing forks-keyed step_build_fork/step_materialize_fork loop instead of a bespoke singular block. This app has exactly one key ('media-center') because it IS the fork (no separate thin hub) — see top-level mode:'single-app'.
media-center._doc_pinned_tag: Re-verified 2026-07-26 via GitHub API tag list: there is NO tag literally named '5.1.0' — a prior scaffold pass fabricated it. Real tags (newest first): 5.1.1-51101-nightly, 5.1.0-51005-nightly, 5.1.0-51004-nightly, 5.1.0-51003-nightly, 5.1.0-51002-nightly, 5.1.0-51001-nightly, 5.0.3-50301-nightly, 5.0.2-50201-nightly, 5.0.0-50002-nightly, 4.3.1-43101-nightly, 4.3.0. Upstream ships nightlies as its de facto release channel — there is no recent non-nightly tag; 4.3.0 is the last plain-semver tag. Pinned to the newest tag, 5.1.1-51101-nightly, deviating from house convention (ea_cloud-mail pins a stable FairEmail tag) only because no recent stable tag exists. REVIEW this pin whenever upstream cuts an actual stable release.

build._doc: gradle_task_by_abi VERIFIED against a real GHA build (run 30535280370) plus upstream app/build.gradle.kts. Upstream declares `flavorDimensions += listOf("abi","ml")` and generates one abi flavor per key of `abiVersionCodes` = arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64 / x86 / universal. Gradle capitalizes only the FIRST letter of a flavor name, so the hyphen SURVIVES in the task name: assembleArm64-v8aNoMLRelease, NOT assembleArm64V8aNoMLRelease. Run 30535280370 failed with exactly that: "Task assembleArm64V8aNoMLRelease not found ... Some candidates are: assembleArm64-v8aNoMLRelease". We select the NoML flavor (skips upstream on-device ML models) + Release build type. The engine picks the entry matching COMMS_BUNDLE_ABI, falling back to .gradle_task.
build._doc_ml_asset_pack: Upstream declares an asset pack module `:ml-models` (`assetPacks += listOf(":ml-models")`) alongside the WithML/NoML flavor dimension. UNCONFIRMED: whether the NoML flavor we build still pulls in the :ml-models asset pack at the Gradle Play Asset Delivery level, or whether NoML fully excludes it. Do not assume exclusion — verify against the actual `assembleArm64V8aNoMLRelease` output (and `app/build.gradle.kts` asset-pack wiring) on the first real build before relying on this.
build._doc_gradle_task_legacy: gradle_task retained as the single-ABI fallback and is DEPRECATED for this app; the by_abi map above is authoritative. It is intentionally left pointing at the arm64 task so a build with no COMMS_BUNDLE_ABI set still targets the phone ABI.
build._doc_signing: VERIFIED against upstream app/build.gradle.kts: signingConfigs.release sets storeFile = file("release_key.jks") (relative to the app/ module) and reads storePassword/keyAlias/keyPassword from System.getenv("SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD"/"SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS"/"SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD"). ReFra never reads a keystore.properties — the string "keystore.properties" does not appear anywhere in its gradle files. The previous value "keystore_properties" was copied verbatim from ea_cloud-mail (FairEmail DOES read that file) and made GHA run 30538571570 fail at configure time with: storeFile specifies file .../app/release_key.jks which doesnt exist. storeFile resolves during CONFIGURATION, so the engine must place the keystore before the task graph is built. Still the ONE shared vault key (.signing.vault_keystore) — this only changes DELIVERY, never which key signs.

media-center.comment: ReFra (ex-Gallery, com.dot.gallery). Pure Kotlin/Compose, no RN/Cordova wrapper — closest in shape to the FairEmail fork (native gradle build, keystore.properties signing), not to the RN/Cordova forks in ea_cloud-comms. No patches/ series exists yet (empty tracker checkout at pinned tag is valid during scaffolding, per cloud-comms-fork-engine.sh::step_materialize_fork's 'no patches yet' path).

release._doc: Per-APK distribution, same data-driven pattern as ea_cloud-ide::release / ea_cloud-mail::release. {sha} → git short sha, {version_name} → android.version_name.

abis._doc: ABI build axis. arm64-v8a is the device default; x86_64 covers Waydroid/emulator debugging (mirrors ea_cloud-ide::release.abis).

ghcr._doc: ORAS push as an OCI artifact (APK is a blob, not a container). Mirrors ea_cloud-ide::release.ghcr shape.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release 'latest', overwritten every main push, mirrors ea_cloud-ide::release.gh_release and ea_cloud-mail's shared rolling release pattern so /releases/latest/download/cloud-media-center.apk stays stable. Consumed by ea_cloud-superapp ui.external_apps[cloud-media-center].install_apk_url once wired there.
